src.title: Wholesale inflation rises to 12.29% in October as fuel, power prices surge

dossier.headline: Wholesale inflation climbs to 12.29% in October
dossier.summary: Wholesale inflation rose to 12.29% in October from 11.39% in September, above the 12.10% consensus. Fuel and power inflation jumped to 32.84% from 25.85%, while food eased to 8.58% and manufactured goods to 9.54%. It follows October retail inflation of 6.09%, above the RBI's 6% ceiling, as talk of a December rate hike builds.
why_it_matters: Wholesale prices feed into retail inflation and the RBI's rate path
Crude petroleum and gas prices were up 57.32% year on year in September
